title: Baa Juice Cherry Peach Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Cherry Peach Lemonade combines the tangy richness of ripe Cherry, the soft sweetness of juicy Peach, and the zesty sparkle of Lemonade. This vibrant and refreshing blend delivers a smooth and satisfying vape, perfect for fans of fruity and citrus-inspired e-liquids. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated flavour profile, designed to replicate the bold, intense taste found in single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and fast nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Cherry Peach Lemonade offers a versatile and economical option for use with refillable vape devices.
